proposals.before: Jia Sheng already declined went, heard Changsha low wet, self thought longevity not long, moreover banished went, intention not self satisfied.
proposals.after: Jia Sheng already took leave and departed; heard Changsha was low and damp; thought to himself longevity would not be long; moreover went away in banishment; his spirits were not at ease.
proposals.reason: 辭往行 means took leave and went, not declined; literal wrongly renders 辭 as declined.

proposals.before: This time Qu Ping already alienated, no longer in position, sent to Qi, looked back, advised Huai Wang said: 'Why not kill Zhang Yi?'
proposals.after: This time Qu Ping already alienated, no longer in position, sent to Qi; upon returning, advised Huai Wang said: 'Why not kill Zhang Yi?'
proposals.reason: 顧反 means returned (came back), not looked back; the idiomatic translation already has upon his return.

decisions.reason: In 賈生既辭往行, 辭往行 means he took leave and set out for Changsha after being appointed Taifu; rendering 辭 as “declined” invents a refusal the Chinese does not support. The proposed literal correctly restores leave-taking and keeps the rest aligned with 聞長沙卑溼, 自以壽不得長, 又以適去, and 意不自得.

In 使於齊，顧反，諫懷王曰, 顧反 is the classical idiom “return / come back,” not a physical looking back; the next clause (remonstrating with King Huai to kill Zhang Yi) follows that return. Replacing “looked back” with “upon returning” corrects the mistranslation without changing attribution or content.
